C-56.IntentSummary: Per-block diagram/chart export: a shared muya exporter builds a self-contained SVG (inlined --pele-* / Vega colours, theme font, theme panel background, natural size) and rasterizes it to a 2× PNG; the editor context menu and the fullscreen block viewer toolbar offer Copy as Image (clipboard writeImage, one new capability), Save as PNG… and Save as SVG… (save dialog + fs write, heading-derived file name); strings in ten locales; unit + e2e coverage; graph and verification updated.

Corner.Situation: Export a Pele diagram in Ink (dark) with the default background
Corner.Expected: SVG/PNG carry the Ink code-panel background rect and resolved colours; no var(--pele-*) remains; text stays readable outside Mark

Corner.Situation: Export from the block viewer while zoomed ×3 and panned
Corner.Expected: the full diagram at natural size (PNG 2× natural), not the visible viewport crop

Corner.Situation: Right-click on a paragraph, table, code block or KaTeX block
Corner.Expected: no image export items in the menu (non-goal types excluded)

Corner.Situation: Block in error (keep-last-good stale SVG) / block that never rendered
Corner.Expected: stale: exports the last good SVG; never rendered: items disabled, no exception

Corner.Situation: Save dialog cancelled; clipboard write rejected
Corner.Expected: no file, no toast of success; a failure notice with a log marker, no unhandled rejection

Corner.Situation: Document with no heading above the block / heading with non-ASCII (Russian) text
Corner.Expected: file name falls back to "<doc>-diagram-N"; non-ASCII headings slug to a safe, non-empty name
writeImage permitted; save works only through the user-selected dialog path; no new entitlement

T-001.Notes: src/muya/lib/utils/diagramExport.js v1.0.0 (MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY + START_BLOCK anchors): buildStandaloneSvg (clone-only — the live SVG is never mutated; every var(--pele-*) replaced with the buildPeleVariables(readActiveThemeTokens()) value, resolved values XML-escaped so a quoted font stack cannot break serialization; theme font on the root when absent; background rect of vars['--pele-bg'] first child, background:false = transparent; natural size = data-natural-width → viewBox width → px width attr, height by viewBox ratio, getBoundingClientRect last resort, null when underivable; root id + data-natural-width dropped, width/height/viewBox set to natural, inline width/height/max-width/min-width cleared; script/.ag-pele-error removed, on* attrs and javascript: hrefs stripped), rasterizeSvg (data: URL → img.decode() → canvas at scale× (default 2) → toBlob PNG → bytes; createCanvas/makeImage injectable for jsdom), pngIhdrSize (IHDR width/height reader shared by the e2e), suggestFileName/slugifyName (unicode \p{L}\p{N} kept — Cyrillic headings slug to Cyrillic; whitespace/_ → '-'; 64-char cap; <doc>-diagram-N fallback), nearestHeadingText (previous-sibling + ancestor walk, last heading in document order, stops at #ag-editor-id), resolveDiagramExportFigure/diagramExportSvg (role-gated MERMAID/VEGA-LITE; accepts figure, any inner target, or the LIVE preview div the viewer dispatches; null for never-rendered blocks). Unit tests/renderer/muya/diagram-export.test.js v1.0.0 (corners 1/4/6 + the rasterizer). Gates to be run by the orchestrator: npx vitest run tests/renderer/muya/diagram-export.test.js.

Evidence.OrchestratorReview: Review fixes before merge: (1) PRODUCT BUG — writeImage(pngBytes) fails at runtime without tauri's image-png feature ("expected RGBA image data, found raw bytes"); enabled features = ["devtools", "image-png"] on the existing tauri dependency (the png crate was already in Cargo.lock — one lock line, no new crate); the e2e mock could not catch it. (2) PRODUCT BUG — a right-click on a rendered diagram preview (contenteditable=false) collapses the selection, muya's contextmenu handler early-returned, so the export items were unreachable in the real app; clickEvent.js v1.3.0 dispatches 'contextmenu' for figure targets without a cursor. (3) rasterizeSvg called img.decode() before setting src (rejects in Chromium/WebKit) → onload/onerror after src. (4) untitled tabs no longer leak "Untitled-N" into the default file name; (5) suggestFileName fallback produced diagram-diagram-N. (6) menu order: image items after copy/paste. (7) e2e: the dialog mock reads { options }, the empty-fence right-click re-locates after the caret click. Gates: diagram-export unit 20/20; Playwright chromium + webkit (diagram-export, block-viewer, pele-render, zoom) 74/74; cargo check 0 errors.
